sections.h2: Feedstock prices: maize up 7.7%, rice up 12.1%, paddy down 2.0% in three weeks

chart.title: Maize and rice mandi prices rose from 23 Jul to 11 Aug 2026; paddy fell
chart.sub: Change in national average modal price, 23 Jul to 11 Aug 2026, %.

sections.means: Maize rose 7.7% and rice 12.1% over the window, while raw paddy fell 2.0%.
sections.todo: Agmarknet should add daily arrival quantities to its price feed so demand-led and supply-led moves can be told apart.

sections.h2: Maize's mandi price stayed below its Kharif 2026-27 support price

chart.title: Maize averaged ₹2,342 per quintal on 11 Aug, under its ₹2,410 MSP
chart.sub: National average modal price and Kharif 2026-27 MSP, ₹ per quintal.
chart.source: Agmarknet via data.gov.in; PIB, Kharif 2026-27 MSP.

sections.means: Both maize readings sat below the ₹2,410 per quintal MSP, which the post says CACP set with a 56% margin built in.
sections.todo: The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas should publish a quarterly feedstock-cost index for maize, FCI rice and molasses against ethanol offtake prices.

sections.h2: CBAM certificate price rose to €82.32 in Q3 2026, but ethanol is outside its scope

chart.title: The EU CBAM certificate price rose to €82.32 per tonne in Q3 2026
chart.sub: EU CBAM quarterly certificate price, € per tCO₂e.
chart.source: European Commission, CBAM certificate prices, as cited in the post.

sections.means: The CBAM prices are €75.36 for Q1, €75.28 for Q2 and €82.32 for Q3 2026, and its scope covers steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, hydrogen and electricity, not ethanol.
sections.todo: The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change and the Department of Commerce should publish whether CCTS instruments qualify as a carbon price under CBAM Article 9.
